title: FEDERAL NATIONAL MORTGAGE ASSOCIATION FANNIE MAE 8-K Filing — 2026-04-29
summary: Fannie Mae filed an 8-K on April 29, 2026, announcing it had filed its Q1 2026 10-Q quarterly report and is issuing a press release along with an earnings presentation and financial supplement (Exhibits 99.1, 99.2, 99.3). The filing is a notification wrapper—the substantive financial content is embedded in the attached exhibits, which are referenced but not included in the body text provided.
key_points: Fannie Mae filed its quarterly report on Form 10-Q for the quarter ended March 31, 2026
The company issued a press release, earnings presentation, and financial supplement for 1Q 2026
Copies are available on Fannie Mae's website under Investor Relations
The 8-K is signed by Chryssa C. Halley, Executive Vice President and CFO, dated April 29, 2026
The filing contains no substantive financial data, forecasts, or commentary in the body text—only references to attached exhibits
why_it_matters: This 8-K is a standard regulatory wrapper for Fannie Mae's Q1 2026 earnings. The body text contains no substantive financial data—only references to attached exhibits (99.1 press release, 99.2 earnings presentation, 99.3 financial supplement). For research on macro catalysts or market structure, the actual exhibits would need to be retrieved. GSE earnings can be relevant to housing finance and credit markets, but this source alone provides no actionable information.
macro_context: Fannie Mae is a government-sponsored enterprise (GSE) critical to the secondary mortgage market. Its earnings reports can signal credit market conditions and housing sector health, but this 8-K filing contains no such data—the exhibits with the actual figures are referenced but not included.
